image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on yellow flowers. The butterfly's wings are spread open, displaying the dorsal side which is dark brown with distinct rows of eyespots (ocelli). A second partial butterfly is visible on the right edge. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage.

While legs are present, their connection to the thorax is somewhat indistinct and blurry, lacking the precise joint articulation expected in high-fidelity macro photography. It is difficult to count exactly six distinct, properly jointed legs.
